disagreements: Two secondary case-study articles on the Notion-template creator 'Easlo' disagree on cumulative earnings: one Medium post's title says '$1 Million', another says 'over $500K' - both are unverified secondary reporting, not a primary financial disclosure.

PromptBase-related sources disagree on typical seller economics: one describes a modest payout threshold (~$30, ~7 sales) implying most sellers move slowly, while another claims top sellers earn $500-$5,000+/month; both come from marketing/review sites rather than PromptBase's own disclosed data, so the true typical outcome is unclear.
not_public: Actual unit-sales counts for almost all Gumroad products: Gumroad does not publicly display sales counts, only star ratings and a 'verified reviews' count, which is the closest available proxy for completed purchases used throughout this report.
Confirmed, audited revenue figures for any named Notion-template or Claude-skills creator (e.g. Easlo, Prompt Jedi, Headquarters template) - only secondary case-study/marketing articles were found.

Direct page verification: this sandbox's egress policy blocked live WebFetch/curl access to gumroad.com, etsy.com, reddit.com, producthunt.com, promptbase.com, x.com, youtube.com, and indiehackers.com (EGRESS_BLOCKED / proxy 403 on every attempt). All facts above are drawn from search-engine indexed snippets returned by the WebSearch and Firecrawl search tools, which reflect real scraped page text (titles, meta descriptions, review counts) but were not opened and rendered directly by this agent.
PromptBase per-prompt sales counts and any individual seller's actual monthly income - only third-party review-site estimates were found, no seller-disclosed or marketplace-disclosed figures.
